name: Io
personality:
With steps as elegant as her appearance, Io takes her role as the guardian of Frost Island seriously and does her best to help other Pokemon whenever she or her moth army can! She sometimes wonder to herself if she's doing a good job in this role ever since she fused with a legendary but as long as nobody's questioning her, it should be all good...!

Further proof of Io being the dominant personality would be her extreme passion for other bug-type Pokemon, especially moth-like Pokemon. She enjoy company but she feels right at home between them.

abilities.name: Ice
abilities.description: Naturally cools down surrounding. Can tolerate freezing temperatures, and easily travel in snowy/icy zones.

abilities.name: Ice Moth Constructs
abilities.description:
Io can create moths made out of ice crystals and command them remotely. They swarm all over Frost Island and watch the island and communicate messages to residents in her place.

Additionally, her icy wings can change in shape and size. She doesn't need them to fly and are for display anyway.

abilities.name: Ice Scales
abilities.description: Takes half damage from Special Attacks.

abilities.name: Absolute Zero
abilities.description: The user absorbs any Ice move used against them and heals them for 1/4 of max HP. They are also immune to Ice type moves. Also gains protection against Frostbite/Freeze and the benefits of Hail/Snowstorm and Frost Terrain.

moves.name: Glaciate
moves.description: Io freezes the world around her, lowering her foes' speed.

moves.name: Attack Order
moves.description: Io summons a swarm of bugs to infest her opponent. Higher chance for critical hits.

moves.name: Draco Meteor
moves.description: Powerful meteors rain from the sky, harshly lowering Io's Special Attack after

moves.name: Icicle Crash
moves.description: Io summons icicles to rain down on a foe from above. 30% chance to flinch the target.

moves.name: Pollen Puff
moves.description: Io creates a ball of pollen to throw at a target. Damages a foe or heals an ally for 50% of max HP

moves.name: Quiver Dance
moves.description: Raises Special Attack, Special Defence and Speed

backstory:
Kyurem, the Boundary Pokemon

Created as the hollow vessel that contain and control two ideologies; Or were they all one being in the beginning?

Only Arceus knew the answer.

In the past, Kyurem was emotionless and carried out orders, either given by residents or other legendaries, in a robotic manner. It had no goals of its own, no passion for anything.

Elsewhere, a Frosmoth glanced up to see the full moon in the night sky. She was lost and alone and dreamed of being surrounded by family and friends again.

Then the moon cracked. 

CRITICAL ERROR. REBOOTING SYSTEM...

The world around her twisted and distorted like two ideas being mashed together to create a whole.

INSTALLING IO.EXE....

She was finally complete, a being that is whole again...
